# Bundled libraries

Built by `tools/build_vendor.sh`; do not edit by hand.

| File | What it is | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `anthropic-sdk.js` | `@anthropic-ai/sdk` 1.8.0, the official Claude SDK | MIT |
| `basic-pitch.js` | `@spotify/basic-pitch` 1.0.1 with TensorFlow.js 3.21 | Apache-2.0 |
| `basic-pitch-model/` | The Basic Pitch model weights | Apache-2.0 |

The instrument samples in `../sounds/` are rendered from the FluidR3_GM soundfont by Frank Wen
(MIT licence) by `tools/render_sounds.py`.
